description: This Java class defines the configuration for the background sync actor in the Eclipse Ditto project, including parsing configuration values, providing accessors, and implementing equality and string representation methods.

classes.name: DefaultBackgroundSyncConfig
classes.description: Final class implementing BackgroundSyncConfig, encapsulating background sync configuration parameters and logic.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Creates a BackgroundSyncConfig instance from a given Config object.

methods.name: fromUpdaterConfig
methods.description: Creates a BackgroundSyncConfig instance from an updater configuration, with fallback.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if background sync is enabled.

methods.name: getQuietPeriod
methods.description: Returns the duration of the quiet period.

methods.name: getKeptEvents
methods.description: Returns the number of kept events.

methods.name: getToleranceWindow
methods.description: Returns the tolerance window duration for out-of-date search index entries.

methods.name: getThrottleThroughput
methods.description: Returns the number of updates per throttle period.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the idle timeout duration for the sync stream.

methods.name: getPolicyAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for policy shard region.

methods.name: getMaxRestarts
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of restarts.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another DefaultBackgroundSyncConfig object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on configuration fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the configuration object.
